bio: Housed in a historic building, skilfully renovated and tastefully furnished, IO's cuisine celebrates the best products of the Italian peninsula. From the freshness of seasonal vegetables to the Mediterranean catch and selected meats, each dish is a journey into authentic flavours. Imagine a traditional lasagna enriched with a touch of lemon zest, or a red mullet accompanied by pork snout and a cuttlefish ink sauce... IO is the ideal place for any occasion. Located in a historic and cosy location, the courtyard becomes a real highlight in fine weather....
